```{r, settings}


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(VGAM)
```

Organizando Bacno e Categorizando

```{r}
student_mat <- read_delim("student-mat.csv", 
    delim = ";", escape_double = FALSE, trim_ws = TRUE)

student_mat$G <- student_mat$G1  + student_mat$G2 + student_mat$G3

student_mat <- student_mat %>%
  mutate(
    G_cat = case_when(
      G < 36 ~ "F",
      G >= 36 & G <= 40 ~ "A",
      G >= 41 & G <= 45 ~ "B",
      G >= 46 & G <= 50 ~ "C",
      G >= 51 & G <= 55 ~ "D",
      G >= 56 & G <= 60 ~ "E",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    G_cat = factor(
      G_cat,
      levels = c("F", "E", "D", "C", "B", "A")
    )
  )

student_mat$G_cat <- relevel(student_mat$G_cat, ref = "F")

cores_G <- c(
  "A" = "#1a9850",  # verde
  "B" = "#66bd63",  # verde claro
  "C" = "#fee08b",  # amarelo
  "D" = "#fc8d59",  # laranja
  "E" = "#f46d43",   # laranja/vermelho
  "F" = "#d73027"  # vermelho
)
```

Análise Descritiva

Categóricas

```{r}

student_mat %>%
  count(G_cat) %>%
  mutate(
    porcentagem = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = G_cat, y = porcentagem, fill = G_cat)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(porcentagem, 1), "%")),
    vjust = -0.5
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cores_G) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribuição das categorias de desempenho",
    x = "Categoria",
    y = "Percentual (%)",
    fill = "Categoria"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


```

```{r}
student_mat %>%
  count(school, G_cat) %>%
  group_by(school) %>%
  mutate(
    porcentagem = 100 * n / sum(n)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = school, y = porcentagem, fill = G_cat)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(porcentagem, 1), "%")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cores_G
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    limits = c(0, 100)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribuição das categorias de G por escola",
    x = "School",
    y = "Percentual",
    fill = "Categoria"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

Numéricas

```{r}
student_mat %>%
  group_by(G_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(age)),
    media = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    dp = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    mediana = median(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q1 = quantile(age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Q3 = quantile(age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

student_mat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = G_cat, y = age, fill = G_cat)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = cores_G
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribuição da idade por categoria de G",
    x = "Categoria de G",
    y = "Idade",
    fill = "Categoria"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )
```

Modelagem

$$
\operatorname{logit}\left[P(G_{\mathrm{cat}}=k)\right]
=
\log\left(
\frac{P(G_{\mathrm{cat}}=k)}
{P(G_{\mathrm{cat}}=F)}
\right)
=
\eta_k
$$

$$
\eta_k
=
\beta_{0k}
+
\beta_{1k}\,\mathrm{age}
+
\beta_{2k}\,\mathrm{studytime}
+
\beta_{3k}\,\mathrm{absences}
+
\beta_{4k}\,\mathrm{sex}
+
\beta_{5k}\,\mathrm{school},
\qquad
k \in \{A,B,C,D,E\}.
$$

$$
P(G_{\mathrm{cat}}=k)
=
\frac{\exp(\eta_k)}
{1+\displaystyle\sum_{j\in\{A,B,C,D,E\}}\exp(\eta_j)}
$$

```{r}
# Referencia é F
modelo <- vglm(
  G_cat ~ age + studytime + absences + sex + school,
  family = multinomial,
  data = student_mat
)

modelo
```
